definitions.gloss: private residence; personal home of a public figure
definitions.explanation: The home a politician, executive, or other public figure owns personally, as opposed to the official residence provided with the post. Used mainly in news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私邸|してい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister returned to his private residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{私邸|してい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Reporters were waiting in front of the private residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公邸|こうてい}→公邸：30126_koutei⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{私邸|してい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ことにした⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was announced that he had decided to commute from his private residence rather than the official one.

notes:
{私|し} (private) + ⟦{邸|てい}→邸：23029_tei⟧ (mansion, residence). Almost always used in contrast with ⟦{公邸|こうてい}→公邸：30126_koutei⟧, the official residence that comes with a government post.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私邸|してい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to one's private residence
- {私邸|してい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit someone's private residence
- ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私邸|してい}: a lawmaker's private residence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{邸宅|ていたく}→邸宅：14434_teitaku⟧: mansion — a large impressive house, with no public/private contrast
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧: one's own home — the everyday word, used of anyone
